content.thinking:
I'm checking each claim against its source: the duration and worst-minute error rate come from the figures, and the update that stopped partway is backed by the Why line. I'm now working through how the old version handled the new format.

I'm confirming the remaining claims: the customer loss estimate comes from the figures, nobody was paged and no on-call incident was linked, and the rollback of the io-shop deployment, which was confirmed to work, is still in place with automatic sync left off.

content.text: The document makes nine claims, and the record supports every one, so I'm not flagging anything.

supported.quote: For {duration}, some shoppers on io-shop could not load their account pages
rows: What a reader saw: Shoppers' account pages failed to load

supported.quote: at the worst minute {peak_error_rate} of requests failed
rows: Requests failing at the worst minute: 24.5% {peak_error_rate}

supported.quote: A software update changed the format of a saved summary of each shopper's spending.
rows: Why, in plain words: A software update changed the format of a saved summary

supported.quote: The update stopped partway, so the older version kept running beside the new one.
rows: Why, in plain words: still running beside the new one because the update stopped partway

supported.quote: The older version could not read the new format, and account pages it served failed.
rows: Why, in plain words: could not read the new format and failed the account page

supported.quote: Argus estimates the lost takings at {customer_loss}.
rows: What it cost the shop in takings (estimated by Argus): 3,022.30 USD {customer_loss}

supported.quote: Nobody was paged, and no on-call incident was linked to this one.
rows: Nobody was paged: no on-call incident was linked to this one.

supported.quote: Argus ended the incident by rolling back the io-shop deployment and confirmed that it worked.
rows: Argus: rolled back the deployment of io-shop - confirmed, still in place

supported.quote: The rollback is still in place, and automatic sync has been left off.
